message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility < 200 ft. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing vehicles must have a red “TOW” sign.
• Tow‑away vehicles must be marked with a red “TOW” sign and a red “TOW” light. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Parking** | • No parking on sidewalks, in front of driveways, or in fire lanes.
• Parking in a “no parking” zone is a ticket. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **School Bus** | • Stop on both sides of the road when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display valid registration and proof of insurance.
• Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 per accident, $25,000 property damage. | Tx Code §545.001 | | **Traffic Cameras & Automated Enforcement** | • Cameras enforce speed limits, red‑light violations, and other infractions. | TxDOT Enforcement Program | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: additional regulations for size, weight, and hazardous materials. | Tx Code §545.001 | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: https://www.txdot.gov - **Texas Transportation Code** – Online legal database: https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/ - **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Driver licensing and enforcement: https://www.dps.texas.gov/ - **Local County Courts** – For specific traffic citations and penalties. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always keep your headlights on** during low‑visibility conditions. 2. **Use hands‑free** if you need to talk on the phone. 3. **Check your mirrors** before changing lanes. 4. **Observe school‑zone speed limits**—they’re there to protect children. 5. **Keep your vehicle’s registration and insurance up to date** to avoid fines. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular traffic ticket!
